description: This PHP class 'DataGroupService' provides services for managing data group permissions, fetching data groups, and obtaining API permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with data access objects and data transfer objects to perform authorization-related operations.

classes.name: DataGroupService
classes.description: Service class for handling data group permission operations, data retrieval, and API permissions within the authorization module.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Returns the DataGroupDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setDao
methods.description: Sets the DataGroupDao instance for this service.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Fetches data group permissions based on provided data groups, user role ID, and permission type.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all data groups defined in the system.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Fetches a specific data group by name.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Gets resource permissions for a specific API class based on roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of data group permissions based on provided filter parameters.
